title: OpenAI and America’s SBDC launch practical AI training for small businesses
friendlyTitle: Small businesses get hands-on help with AI
summary: OpenAI is partnering with America’s Small Business Development Centers to train about 150 advisers and initially reach at least 1,000 businesses through workshops and follow-up support. A companion report describes small firms using AI for finance, supply chains, compliance and marketing.
friendlySummary: OpenAI and America’s SBDC will train local advisers and run workshops to help small businesses use AI on real work.
whyItMatters: The program puts guided experimentation closer to owners who lack dedicated AI staff. Its best lesson travels beyond the US: start with a real task, measure whether the tool helps, and keep a trusted human adviser in the loop.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Owners can get practical support instead of trying every AI tool alone. The useful approach is to begin with one clear business problem.
